items.when: sub-question asks for a player who achieved a specific scoring milestone (e.g., scored 63 points) at a named venue
items.action: Route to doc as primary source; KG player schema lacks game-specific scoring performance fields.
items.lesson: KG has no relation linking player to scoring events at venues; doc narratives contain such details.
items.evidence: Record 1143: doc primary returned correct player (Hersey Hawkins); KG primary would fail.

items.action: Route to doc as primary source; KG has no relation linking team to a 'headlining player' for championships.
items.lesson: KG team schema lacks championship player relations; doc narratives contain such details.
items.evidence: Record 1142: doc primary returned correct player (Julius Erving); KG primary would fail.

items.evidence: Record 1130: doc primary returned correct school (University of Houston); KG primary would be less reliable.

items.when: sub-question contains a venue name and asks for a player who performed an action there
items.action: Parse the venue as the known entity and the player as the return type; use doc for the relation.
items.lesson: Venue names are reliable anchors for doc searches; player is the target entity.
items.evidence: Records 1143, 1130: venue-based queries correctly parsed with venue as entity and player as return type.

items.when: sub-question contains a team name, venue name, and time period, asking for a player
items.action: Parse team as the known entity, venue and time as conditions, player as return type; route to doc.
items.lesson: Team+venue+time is a complex condition that KG cannot resolve; doc narratives contain player rosters.
items.evidence: Record 1151: semantic parse correctly identified entities and conditions but KG failed to return answers.

items.when: sub-question asks for a player's school or place of birth using [1] reference
items.action: Parse [1] as the known entity and the attribute (school/place of birth) as the relation; route to KG for place of birth, doc for school.
items.lesson: [1] references are correctly resolved as player entities; attribute queries work well with KG for structured fields.
items.evidence: Records 1142, 1130: [1] references correctly parsed and resolved.

items.when: sub-question asks for a player who performed an action at a venue
items.action: Plan a single path: Search venue in doc, then Relate to player; use Filter for additional conditions.
items.lesson: Venue-first search in doc is effective for player identification; filter conditions refine results.
items.evidence: Records 1143, 1130: venue-first plans returned correct players.

items.when: sub-question asks for a player who played for a team at a venue during a time period
items.action: Plan a single path: Search team in doc, then Relate to player, then Filter by venue and time.
items.lesson: Team-first search in doc with venue/time filters is necessary; KG cannot handle this complex relation.
items.evidence: Record 1151: KG-based plan returned no answers; doc-based plan would have succeeded.

items.action: Plan a single path: Search [1] in KG, then Relate to the attribute; use doc as fallback.
items.lesson: KG attribute lookup is efficient for structured player fields; doc fallback handles missing data.
items.evidence: Records 1142, 1130: KG attribute lookups returned correct answers.
